issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, while the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on their own domain.

issues.title: Secure certificate (padlock) after connecting
issues.problem_statement: Support said the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain; whether it has been issued is not yet confirmed.

items.description: Support explained that an old A record pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record using the target value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; support then saw the dashboard show the domain as connected and the customer confirmed it loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Customer deleted a second record for the www version and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed both the domain and its www version now load the funnel.
evidence: Both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version are loading our funnel now.

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
